lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I go in my room and play Playstation 2.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Is anybody else home at that time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No, Bobbie was, he was gone bow hunting.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. In previous statements you had told us that you had left on your bike to go get the mail. Was that true?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you hear any screaming or anything like you had told us previously?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. So you get home at 3:45 and you play Playstation and you play Playstation until what time?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then what happens at 5:00 o'clock?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Mom gets home so, I talk to her for a little bit, then she left with Scott.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, and whose home at this time then?
